description: pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs web_pki_policy(): The 398-day validity limit references TLS BR §6.3.2 which was the current limit as of writing. CA/B Forum Ballot SC-081 (approved March 2024) reduces TLS certificate maximum validity to 47 days effective April 2027 via phased reduction (398→200→100→47 days). The current code is correct for deployed CAs today, but by April 2026 (when the first phase drops to 200 days) the 398-day limit in web_pki_policy will be too permissive. Either add a doc comment noting this is the pre-SC-081 limit, or make the validity parameterizable. Tracking this now prevents a silent security regression when SC-081 phases take effect.
title: web_pki_policy 398-day limit will become stale with CA/B Forum SC-081
